queries_run: eBay distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
eBay business model transition platform agentic commerce 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述 eBay 營收來源為 Marketplace 佣金與 Advertising 廣告費，以 GMV 抽成（take rate）為主，策略聚焦 enthusiasts 與 AI；未見訂閱化或 D2C 轉型表述。
findings.excerpt: We generate net revenues through two activities, Marketplace activities which primarily consist of commissions from the service of connecting buyers and sellers on our secure and trusted Marketplace platforms and Advertising activities, which primarily consist of fees charged to sellers to promote their listings.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要多為轉述無法逐字複製，故以 clues 保留：更新用戶協議（2026-02-20 生效）禁止第三方 buy-for-me AI 代理下單；eBay 轉向自建 agentic commerce；10-Q 載明 2026-10-20 宣布裁員約9%；報導 Depop 收購。

clues.claim: eBay 用戶協議自 2026-02-20 起禁止 buy-for-me 代理／LLM 機器人未經人工審核下單，同時自建 agentic 購物
clues.source: Resultsense: eBay bans AI shopping agents

clues.claim: eBay 2026-10-20 宣布重組，裁員約9%，成本 1.3–1.5 億美元
